eval_binding._note: TWO-STAGE BINDING (task §二). ENGINE-STAGE certificates (written by tier3_evaluator.py) carry every field EXCEPT the exit-provenance block and must NOT contain any of them (NEG37). The RUNNER (tier3_evaluation_runner.py) injects the exit-provenance block below ONLY after wait()-ing on the engine child and reading its LITERAL exit code, then runs full verification (NEG29). Legacy self-declared fields (run_exit_code / process_pid / process_argv / run_start_utc / run_end_utc) are FORBIDDEN in every binding. 64-hex values below are documentation placeholders.
eval_binding._run_class_note: run_class ∈ {INTERFACE_SMOKE, PERFORMANCE_EVALUATION, PROVISIONAL_STRONG_STUDENT_SELECTION, FORMAL_EVALUATION, ROUND1_SCREENING}. ROUND1_SCREENING (总控 §四): a declared screening SUBSET of the frozen schedule — FULL seeds 200000..200007 (prefix of the frozen 64), FRONT/BACK frozen bank indices (0,5), max_timesteps=4096; it NEVER authorizes strong-student selection or scientific superiority claims.
eval_binding._bank_provenance_note: BANK PROVENANCE (总控 §一.8; NEG46-NEG49). Conditional on bank_kind. (a) bank_kind=FROZEN_SCAFFOLD_BANK (FRONT/BACK): bank_source=FROZEN_SERIALIZED_ARTIFACT for EVERY formal run class — the bank was minted ONCE on a pinned CPU venv, serialized to an immutable artifact (tier3_frozen_bank_artifacts.py), loaded read-only on the eval device, converted back to host NumPy, and its canonical_content_sha256 recomputed: bank_regenerated_on_eval_device must be exactly false, artifact_file_sha256 + loaded_content_sha256 must be 64-hex, and loaded_content_sha256 must EQUAL state_bank_hash (the loaded states canonicalize to the frozen bank hash); device_provenance must carry non-empty 'mint' and 'load' identity dicts. bank_source=REGENERATED_IN_MEMORY is permitted ONLY for run_class=INTERFACE_SMOKE (chain verification, never a formal binding): bank_regenerated_on_eval_device=true, both artifact SHAs null. (b) bank_kind=CANONICAL_RESET_SEEDS (FULL): bank_source=CANONICAL_RESET_SEEDS, bank_regenerated_on_eval_device=true, both artifact SHAs null, device_provenance={'eval_device': {...}}. The bank generator must NEVER run during formal evaluation (GPU_REGENERATION_DISABLED).

evaluation_seed_schedule._note: task §七 frozen schedule; identical for BOTH arms. full = 64 held-out canonical reset seeds 200000..200063; front_l2/back_l2 = all 8 frozen bank states each exactly once. ROUND1_SCREENING bindings carry a declared subset instead: full kind=canonical_reset_seeds_screening_prefix (seeds = prefix of the frozen 64, screening_of_frozen_schedule = the full 64), front_l2/back_l2 kind=frozen_bank_state_screening_subset (bank_indices strictly ascending in [0,8), seeds = the frozen bank states at those indices, screening_of_frozen_schedule = the frozen 8-seed schedule). NEG43-NEG45.

eval_binding._exit_provenance_note: RUNNER-SUPPLIED ONLY (task §二) — present iff the certificate was finalized by tier3_evaluation_runner.py after a literal wait() exit code 0; absent (and forbidden) in engine-stage certificates.
